pollTemplates.title: Saved polls
pollTemplates.description: Keep private poll settings and start a fresh public poll in Discord. Votes and voters are never stored in templates.
pollTemplates.removeHelp: Remove these saved settings? Existing polls will remain unchanged.
pollTemplates.name: Template name
pollTemplates.question: Poll question
pollTemplates.optionsHelp: Two to five unique options, one per line; up to 200 characters each.
pollTemplates.hidden: Hide results until the poll closes (off by default)
pollTemplates.independent: Editing or removing saved settings never changes polls already started.
pollTemplates.failed: Could not update your saved polls. Try again.
pollTemplates.startHelp: In the channel where you want to publish, use /polls start template:{id}.
pollTemplates.rankedHelp: Voters rank options privately. Partial rankings are allowed; an absolute majority of remaining ballots wins. Elimination ties stay unresolved. Multiple choice is disabled.
